user.title: ShutterManager
user.description: General settings. Add rooms afterwards via “Configure”.

data_description.open_delay: How long a window must be open before the shutters go up.
data_description.close_delay: How long all windows of the room must be closed before the shutters go back.

data_description.contacts: While one is open, closed shutters move to their vent position.
data_description.lockout: While a window is open no shutter goes below its vent position, not even by button, app, plan or automation. The command is carried out once all contacts are closed. Door shutters are always protected.
data_description.door_contacts: Patio or balcony doors. While one is open, the door shutters go up to the door position and nothing can lower them, so nobody gets locked out.

data_description.contacts: While one is open, closed shutters move to their vent position.
data_description.lockout: While a window is open no shutter goes below its vent position, not even by button, app, plan or automation. The command is carried out once all contacts are closed. Door shutters are always protected.
data_description.door_contacts: Patio or balcony doors. While one is open, the door shutters go up to the door position and nothing can lower them, so nobody gets locked out.

room_positions.title: Vent position in {room}
room_positions.description:
How far each shutter opens for ventilation, in percent (0 = closed, 100 = fully open). When a window opens, only shutters below this position go up. When the window closes they return to their previous position, unless someone moved them in the meantime.

{covers}

data_description.door_position: How far the door shutters open while a door is open.
data_description.door_covers: Shutters in front of a door. None chosen: all shutters of the room.

data_description.open_delay: How long a window must be open before the shutters go up.
data_description.close_delay: How long all windows of the room must be closed before the shutters go back.

error.no_cover: Please choose at least one shutter.
error.no_contact: Please choose at least one window or door contact.
error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.
error.cover_in_use: A chosen shutter already belongs to another room.
error.contact_twice: A contact can be a window or a door contact, not both.

pause.name: Pause schedule
pause.description: Pause all shutter plans. Ventilation and lockout protection keep working. Without duration or end, the pause lasts until resumed.

resume.name: Resume schedule
resume.description: End the pause. Shutters move again at the next plan change.

start_vacation.name: Start vacation
start_vacation.description: All rooms with a plan follow the vacation plan until the end.

random.name: Random delay
random.description: Each move happens up to this many minutes later, so the house does not look empty.

end_vacation.name: End vacation
end_vacation.description: Rooms follow their own plans again.

apply_plan.name: Apply plan now
apply_plan.description: Move a room's shutters to where its plan has them right now.
